title: One Variable
thesis_this_serves: Whether a data center on offered Air Force land makes a Fairbanks power bill smaller or bigger turns on one number, the load, and nobody has published it. The look has to make an ABSENCE the most visible thing in the film.

roles.sky: #3E3852  Interior dusk violet, late September, the hour after the sun leaves the ridge
roles.ground: #C9A227  birch gold, the Tanana valley in the last week of September
roles.hero: #C87137  copper, literally the colour of wire, and the film's WIRES half
roles.accent: #1F3A5F  carbon blue, the ink of a printed form, and the film's FUEL half
roles.paper: #EDE7DB  statement stock, warm off-white, never pure white

palette.mood: A cold, clear, ordinary evening in a working town. Not ominous. The film is not about dread, it is about a blank line on a form, so the world is legible and calm and the only unsettled thing in it is the one slot that will not resolve.
palette.divergence: 2026-09-14 was bright ultramarine, mango, alabaster and sea-glass. 2026-09-19 was powerhouse green, sodium amber and model cyan. This has NO cyan, NO green, NO amber and NO ultramarine. Copper against carbon blue over dusk violet has not been run. The gold is the only warm note carried over from any recent film and it is doing different work here, as autumn ground rather than as a light source.

light.time_of_day: 19:40, late September, Interior Alaska. Sun already behind the ridge.
light.direction: low and raking from frame LEFT, about 8 degrees above the horizon line
light.key: birch gold, warm, narrow, catching only the top third of standing forms and the upper edge of every ruled card
light.fill: dusk violet, cold and broad, from the open sky above
light.rim: copper rim on the right edge of every hero form, which is the light that says an object is REAL and built, and which the absence grammar deliberately does not get
light.depth_approach: Three declared planes everywhere there is a world: a far ridge and spruce band at 18 percent contrast with atmospheric lift, a mid plane carrying the subject at full contrast, and a near foreground of alder and a cut bank at 130 percent contrast and slight blur. Stage3D planes with a composed camera move on every exterior. Forms read dimensional by a three-tone ladder plus contact shadow, never by a flat fill.

shape_language.grammar: THE RULED FORM AGAINST THE UNRULED LAND.
shape_language.why_this_story: The film's argument is literally that a rectangle is being drawn over ground that is not rectangular, and that one row on the rectangle is blank. So every human-made element is hard rectilinear, ruled, gridded, right-angled and repeating: statement rows, parcel boundaries, the cost stack, nameplates, a section grid. Every natural element is irregular and non-repeating: spruce crowns, a ridge, alder, the cut bank, a river bend. The two never blend. Where they meet, the ruled thing sits ON TOP of the land and casts a shadow onto it, so the viewer sees an imposition rather than a fit.
shape_language.the_deliberate_contrast: Rectilinear institution against organic land is the shelf's established opposition (ServerMachine and MachineShadow against Sourdough). This film uses it but INVERTS the sympathy: the ruled form is not a villain here, it is a DOCUMENT, and the film's complaint is not that it exists but that one of its rows is empty.

casting.hero_reason: The throughline object and the hero are the same thing, which is correct for a film about a missing value. It is a ruled utility statement with line items, a total, and one row whose value slot never fills. It must differ from the last two heroes and it does: 2026-09-14 was GearLever and 2026-09-19 was RunOfRiver.
from_the_shelf: Unnamed and UnnamedField (lib/absence.tsx) for every NOT DISCLOSED slot. The shelf already solved drawing a thing that is not there, with a dashed crawling contour, a true void interior, a slow drift so it never reads as unrendered, and a REQUIRED label. It is exactly right and it is not being rebuilt.
Nameplate and StatCard (lib/props.tsx), form-shaded by default since 2026-07-30, for Hollister, Murkowski and Hopkins and for every figure
BoundaryReveal (lib/props.tsx) traces the offered parcel as a closed path over the land
MeasuringChain and SurveyStake (lib/props.tsx) for the land being measured to the acre
Character rig for the Fairbanks household, the trail walker and the figures at the testimony beats, with boxed name labels per the scene recipe book
DawnForestBG (boreal birch and spruce) for the land plane, re-tinted to dusk
MainStreetBG for the town beat, dusk raised
materials.tsx paper substance under every ruled card so no surface is a flat fill
casting.why_the_shelf_covers_so_much: Checked against ASSET_MANIFEST.md in full before deciding. The shelf carries thirteen biomes, a props kit whose copy is all parameters, a full absence grammar and an evidence-state grammar. The only genuine gap this story finds is a BILL, which is the one thing it needs most.

motion_language.world: Slow, settled, domestic. The camera pushes about 1.00 to 1.08 across every held shot with a lateral drift on an irrational period, and every exterior has a far plane drifting against the push. Nothing whips except the two act transitions.
hero_moves_named: ROWS FILLING. The statement's rows populate left to right with a typed tick per row, anticipation and a small overshoot on each value as it lands. This is the film's signature motion and it is designed to build an expectation the blank row then breaks.
THE ROW THAT REFUSES. Every other row lands with a hit. One row's value slot arrives and does not fill. Its dashed rule crawls, its interior drifts, and it never resolves for the rest of the film.
THE STACK SPLITTING. The single cost bar over the house divides into two named halves, wires and fuel, with a real seam and a physical shove apart.
THE HALF THAT THINS. The wires half compresses smoothly and settles, once, and stays settled. It is the only thing in the film that gets ANSWERED.
THE HALF THAT SWINGS. The fuel half oscillates between two heights on a spring that never damps, because the value that would settle it is the blank row. It is still swinging in the button.
motion_language.earns_180_blur: the two act whips and the stack shove apart. Nothing else.

composition.approach: Focal hierarchy is absolute: in every shot the best-finished, highest-contrast, most-detailed object is the one the viewer is meant to read, and the statement card is never out-detailed by its own furniture.
composition.safe_area_intent: THE 9:16 MASTER IS THE GRADED CUT AND IS COMPOSED FOR. The square is derived at crop=1080:1080:0:420, so the STORY lives inside master y 420 to 1500 and nothing load-bearing crosses those lines. The canvas outside that band is used rather than padded: ridge, sky and drifting cloud above y=420, and a near foreground of alder, cut bank and the corner of a porch rail below y=1500. This is the defect that dominated the back half of 2026-09-19 and it is being designed for up front instead of repaired at delivery.
composition.signature_shot: THE DIAGRAM THAT CANNOT RESOLVE. One tall cost bar standing over a thin row of small houses. It splits into a copper WIRES half and a carbon-blue FUEL half. The wires half thins and settles. The fuel half swings between two heights and will not stop. Between them, where the number that would settle it belongs, sits a dashed void slot labelled NOT DISCLOSED. One frame that contains the whole argument, including the part the film honestly cannot answer.

craft_advance.what: It draws a missing OBJECT, a silhouette that is not filled. This film needs a missing VALUE, which is type in a ruled slot rather than a shape, and that is a different problem: a dashed outline around empty space reads as a box, not as an unanswered field. Extending it with a ruled data row whose value slot is a true void with a crawling dashed BASELINE and a required label makes every future rate case, budget, permit, docket and disclosure story able to draw what was not filled in.
craft_advance.why_it_belongs_to_this_film: The single most important image in this Dispatch is a blank line on a form. If the shelf can only draw missing OBJECTS, that image has to be improvised inline, which is exactly how the 2026-07-26 capped-pipe weakness stayed open for four days and two panels.

components: Statement, the ruled utility statement: a card on paper stock with a masthead, N line items each with a label and a value slot, a rule above the total, and a total row. Every string is a parameter. Rows can be filled, filling, or ABSENT, and an absent row composes with the absence grammar rather than reimplementing it.

CostStack, a single cost bar that can divide into named halves, be re-divided across a row of customers, and animate each half independently, so the two-way arithmetic is one component run twice rather than two hand-built diagrams.
net_new_asset.why_it_is_a_real_gap: Checked against ASSET_MANIFEST.md in full. The shelf has StatCard for one stat, Sheet for paper body, PaperOfficeBG for a records room, and the evidence-state grammar for epistemic status. NOTHING draws a BILL, and nothing draws a cost that divides. Alaska's news is rate cases, tariffs, PCE, budgets, dividends and utility filings almost every week, and every one of them has wanted this.
